workerEnvVars.name: BOT_TOKEN
workerEnvVars.about: Discord bot token. The worker refuses to start without it.

workerEnvVars.name: TOTAL_SHARDS
workerEnvVars.about: Shard count for the ShardingManager, or auto to let Discord decide.

workerEnvVars.name: SHARD_LIST
workerEnvVars.about: Comma-separated shard ids this deployment owns, or auto.

workerEnvVars.name: POSTGRES_URL
workerEnvVars.about: Primary Postgres connection string (point it at PgBouncer in Compose).

workerEnvVars.name: POSTGRES_REPLICA_URL
workerEnvVars.about: Optional read-replica connection string.

workerEnvVars.name: POSTGRES_APP_NAME
workerEnvVars.about: application_name reported to Postgres per process.

workerEnvVars.name: POSTGRES_POOL_MAX
workerEnvVars.about: Explicit per-process pool size. Wins over the budget below.

workerEnvVars.name: POSTGRES_POOL_TOTAL
workerEnvVars.about: Fleet-wide connection budget, divided across shards so scaling out never exhausts max_connections.

workerEnvVars.name: DIRECT_POSTGRES_URL
workerEnvVars.about: Direct Postgres URL used by migrations, bypassing PgBouncer.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_HOST
workerEnvVars.about: Standalone/sentinel Redis host.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_PORT
workerEnvVars.about: Standalone/sentinel Redis port.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_PASSWORD
workerEnvVars.about: Redis password.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_CACHE_DB
workerEnvVars.about: Logical database index for cache data.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_TASK_DB
workerEnvVars.about: Logical database index for scheduled-task data.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_SENTINELS
workerEnvVars.about: Sentinel addresses when running Redis in sentinel mode.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_SENTINEL_NAME
workerEnvVars.about: Sentinel master name.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_SENTINEL_PASSWORD
workerEnvVars.about: Sentinel password.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_CLUSTER_NODES
workerEnvVars.about: Comma-separated host:port list enabling cluster mode.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_CLUSTER_SCALE_READS
workerEnvVars.about: Read scaling policy: master, slave, or all.

workerEnvVars.name: REDIS_CLUSTER_SLOTS_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS
workerEnvVars.about: Slot-refresh timeout for the cluster client.

workerEnvVars.name: RPC_HTTP_HOST
workerEnvVars.about: Bind for the worker RPC/metrics surface. Widened to 0.0.0.0 only on the container the dashboard calls.

workerEnvVars.name: RPC_HTTP_PORT
workerEnvVars.about: Port for the worker RPC/metrics surface.

workerEnvVars.name: RPC_INTERNAL_TOKEN
workerEnvVars.about: Shared secret authenticating dashboard-to-worker RPC. Unset is a hard failure.

workerEnvVars.name: RPC_HTTP_URL
workerEnvVars.about: Base URL of the api RPC server, read only by `lumi doctor` to check reachability.

workerEnvVars.name: RPC_DISCORD_BULKHEAD_SIZE
workerEnvVars.about: Max concurrent guild-manager RPC actions (each makes a Discord REST permission check), so a Discord stall can't starve DB-only actions.

workerEnvVars.name: RPC_DISCORD_BULKHEAD_QUEUE_LIMIT
workerEnvVars.about: Guild-manager RPC calls allowed to wait for a bulkhead slot before new ones fail with a retryable error.

workerEnvVars.name: OWNER_IDS
workerEnvVars.about: Extra bot-owner ids recognized by the permit resolver (the Discord application owner is always an owner).

workerEnvVars.name: LUMI_CONSUMER_ID
workerEnvVars.about: Stable consumer identity for stream processing.

workerEnvVars.name: CLUSTER_NAME
workerEnvVars.about: Namespaces shard telemetry per replica for the fleet view.

workerEnvVars.name: LUMI_DEV_PATHS
workerEnvVars.about: Colon/comma-separated extra module directories for local add-on development. Never set in production.

workerEnvVars.name: DISCORD_PROXY_URL
workerEnvVars.about: Shared outbound REST proxy root (nirn-proxy). Unset means direct Discord API calls.

workerEnvVars.name: DASHBOARD_PUBLIC_URL
workerEnvVars.about: Public dashboard origin used to build appeal links. Unset skips appeal links.

workerEnvVars.name: NODE_ENV
workerEnvVars.about: Runtime environment flag.

workerEnvVars.name: SHARD_COUNT
workerEnvVars.about: Injected by the ShardingManager; do not set yourself.

workerEnvVars.name: SHARDS
workerEnvVars.about: Injected by the ShardingManager as this process's shard id list; do not set yourself.

workerEnvVars.name: SHARDING_MANAGER
workerEnvVars.about: Injected by the ShardingManager to mark a child process; do not set yourself.

workerEnvVars.name: HOSTNAME
workerEnvVars.about: Used as a consumer-id fallback; normally set by the container runtime, not you.

workerEnvVars.name: CACHE_MESSAGE_LIMIT
workerEnvVars.about: Max cached messages per channel.

workerEnvVars.name: CACHE_MEMBER_LIMIT
workerEnvVars.about: Max cached guild members per guild.

workerEnvVars.name: CACHE_THREAD_LIMIT
workerEnvVars.about: Max cached threads per channel.

workerEnvVars.name: CACHE_USER_LIMIT
workerEnvVars.about: Max cached users.

workerEnvVars.name: SWEEPER_MESSAGES_INTERVAL
workerEnvVars.about: Seconds between message-cache sweeps.

workerEnvVars.name: SWEEPER_MESSAGES_LIFETIME
workerEnvVars.about: Seconds a cached message survives before being swept.

workerEnvVars.name: SWEEPER_MEMBERS_INTERVAL
workerEnvVars.about: Seconds between guild-member-cache sweeps.

workerEnvVars.name: SWEEPER_MEMBERS_LIFETIME
workerEnvVars.about: Seconds a cached non-self member survives before being swept.

workerEnvVars.name: DEFAULT_PREFIX
workerEnvVars.about: Legacy text-command prefix.

workerEnvVars.name: SERVICE_NAME
workerEnvVars.about: Service name reported to the logger and observability exporters.

workerEnvVars.name: DB_SLOW_QUERY_THRESHOLD_MS
workerEnvVars.about: Prisma queries slower than this log a warning and increment lumi_db_slow_queries_total.

workerEnvVars.name: ADDON_SIGNATURE_POLICY
workerEnvVars.about: How strictly the Downloader enforces git SSH commit-signature verification before an addon repo/module revision goes live: off, warn, or require.

workerEnvVars.name: ADDON_ALLOWED_SIGNERS_FILE
workerEnvVars.about: Path to a git allowed_signers file listing trusted addon signers. Required (and validated to exist) when ADDON_SIGNATURE_POLICY=require.

workerEnvVars.name: AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS
workerEnvVars.about: How long audit ledger entries survive before the retention sweep purges them.

workerEnvVars.name: CONFIG_HISTORY_RETENTION_DAYS
workerEnvVars.about: How long module config history entries survive before the retention sweep purges them.

workerEnvVars.name: MODERATION_RETENTION_DAYS
workerEnvVars.about: How long a lifted case and its resolved appeal survive before the retention sweep purges them. 0 keeps moderation history forever; active cases and pending appeals are never purged regardless of this setting.

workerEnvVars.name: AUDIT_ARCHIVE_DIR
workerEnvVars.about: Root directory the retention sweep writes a gzip-compressed JSONL archive to before deleting a batch, for any purged table (not just the audit ledger). Unset deletes with no backup.

workerEnvVars.name: GDPR_EXPORT_DIR
workerEnvVars.about: Root directory the async gdpr-export scheduled task writes a user's gzipped JSON export to.

workerEnvVars.name: GDPR_EXPORT_TTL_HOURS
workerEnvVars.about: How long a finished GDPR export's file and job row survive before the hourly cleanup sweep removes them.

workerEnvVars.name: GDPR_EXPORT_SIGNING_SECRET
workerEnvVars.about: HMAC key signing the short-lived GDPR export download token served by GET /gdpr-export. Falls back to RPC_INTERNAL_TOKEN when unset.

dashboardEnvVars.name: DASHBOARD_PUBLIC_URL
dashboardEnvVars.about: Public origin of the dashboard (e.g. https://dash.example.com) for post-invite OAuth2 redirects.

dashboardEnvVars.name: RPC_HTTP_URL
dashboardEnvVars.about: Base URL of the worker RPC server, e.g. http://worker:8091.

dashboardEnvVars.name: RPC_INTERNAL_TOKEN
dashboardEnvVars.about: Shared secret sent as the RPC bearer token. Must match the worker's value; optional only so a local dev worker without the token still works.

dashboardEnvVars.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS
dashboardEnvVars.about: Number of trusted reverse-proxy hops when reading the client IP.

dashboardEnvVars.name: CLIENT_IP_HEADER
dashboardEnvVars.about: Header to trust for the client IP behind a reverse proxy.

dashboardEnvVars.name: AUTH_URL
dashboardEnvVars.about: Externally visible origin when a reverse proxy rewrites Host.

dashboardEnvVars.name: NEXT_PHASE
dashboardEnvVars.about: Set by Next.js itself during `next build`; not something you set.

observabilityEnvVars.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
observabilityEnvVars.about: OTLP endpoint traces are exported to.

observabilityEnvVars.name: LOG_FORMAT
observabilityEnvVars.about: Log encoding: json in Compose, pretty in the dev container.

composeEnvVars.name: POSTGRES_USER
composeEnvVars.about: Postgres superuser name created at init.

composeEnvVars.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
composeEnvVars.about: Postgres password. Change it in any shared deployment.

composeEnvVars.name: GRAFANA_PASSWORD
composeEnvVars.about: *Required only under the observability profile. No default on purpose.

composeEnvVars.name: NIRN_LOG_LEVEL
composeEnvVars.about: Log level for the nirn outbound proxy (scale profile).
